issue.title: On the iOS mobile app, in a 1:1 Teamily Agent chat ("Aiden's Personal AI"), a math formula in an agent reply inside a message bubble is not converted/rendered —
issue.summary: On the iOS mobile app, in a 1:1 Teamily Agent chat ("Aiden's Personal AI"), a math formula in an agent reply inside a message bubble is not converted/rendered — the raw LaTeX source is displayed verbatim, including backslash commands, braces and the $$ delimiters (e.g. CPM = \frac{广告花费}{展示次数} \times 1000 and the block CPM = \frac{500}{100000} \times 1000 = $5). The same message renders correctly on web and macOS, where the display formula is typeset with a proper fraction bar. Reported by Aiden (Teamily CEO) with side-by-side screenshots. Filed separately from #1416 (channel-side Slack/iMessage formula loss) because the root cause here is on the client-side mobile rendering path, not the outbound channel.
steps: Open the Teamily iOS app and enter a 1:1 chat with an agent (reproduced in "Aiden's Personal AI").
Ask the agent a question whose answer contains a math formula — e.g. send "CPM 是什么" (inferred).
Wait for the agent reply, which contains LaTeX formulas — an inline-style formula and a $$-delimited block formula.
Observe the message bubble: the formula is shown as raw LaTeX source code.
Open the same conversation on web / macOS and compare — there the formula renders as typeset math.
issue.expected: Formulas in an agent reply should be rendered as typeset math (LaTeX -> layout) inside the message bubble on every client, consistent with web and macOS.
issue.actual: On the iOS app the formula is not converted: the raw LaTeX source is shown as plain text inside the message bubble — literal \frac{...}{...}, \times, braces and the $$ delimiters are all visible instead of a laid-out formula.
issue.context:
- **Feature area**: Message Rendering / Chat Bubble (client — mobile)
- (inferred) This is the 1:1 Teamily Agent chat displayed as "Aiden's Personal AI".
- Affected container is the message bubble (agent reply). The report does not cover document or card surfaces — please confirm the exact surface is chat bubble only.
- "Instant" mode was selected in the composer (visible in the screenshot); recorded for completeness, unlikely to matter.
- Related but NOT duplicates: #1416 (channel-side Slack/iMessage formula markers lost — outbound channel rendering); #1903 (iOS: @-mention not rendered in the sent bubble); #771 (RN IM text format loss); #978 (rich-text stripped in sender bubble); #1020 (Android RN markdown table clipped); #1823 (forwarding drops rich-text formatting).
- Requested triage: (1) is the iOS app missing the LaTeX -> layout pipeline, or is the renderer/font not taking effect on mobile; (2) iOS only, or Android too; (3) confirm the surface is message bubble vs document vs card.
- Note: on the macOS screenshot a second $$...$$ block formula still shows raw source, i.e. the block-formula delimiter path differs from the inline one — a sub-case of the same rendering pipeline worth covering.
- Reporter: Aiden (Teamily CEO). cc: Cora.

---
issue.environment: - **Platform / OS / Browser**: iOS app (iPhone; status bar time 14:14) — app version not specified, please confirm. Comparison platforms: web + macOS, both normal.
